mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audit_event ( request_id, occurred_at, actor_user_id, actor_role, action, resource_type, resource_id, outcome, http_method, request_path, source_ip, target_host, target_port, user_agent, reason_code, metadata_json, retention_until, created_at ) VALUES ( #{requestId}, #{occurredAt}, #{actorUserId}, #{actorRole}, #{action}, #{resourceType}, #{resourceId}, #{outcome}, #{httpMethod}, #{requestPath}, #{sourceIp}, #{targetHost}, #{targetPort}, #{userAgent}, #{reasonCode}, #{metadataJson}, #{retentionUntil}, NOW() )
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM audit_event WHERE retention_until < NOW() AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM audit_preservation_hold hold_record WHERE hold_record.audit_event_id = audit_event.id AND hold_record.released_at IS NULL )
